questions.stem: 非洲國家打算種下的數百萬棵樹，將被用來築成一道橫跨非洲大陸的綠色長城（Great Green Wall）。
questions.answer: The millions of trees that African countries intend to plant will be used to form a Great Green Wall across the African continent.
accepted_answers: The millions of trees which African countries plan to plant will be used to build a Great Green Wall stretching across Africa.
Millions of trees that African nations are planning to plant will be used to create a Great Green Wall that spans the African continent.

questions.stem: 然而，科學家仍不確定這道綠色長城能否擋住由氣候變遷造成的沙漠擴張。
questions.answer: However, scientists are still not sure whether the Great Green Wall can halt the expansion of deserts caused by climate change.
accepted_answers: However, scientists are still uncertain whether this Great Green Wall can stop the spread of deserts caused by climate change.
However, scientists still do not know if the green wall will be able to hold back the desert expansion brought about by climate change.

1.explanation_zh: 「非洲國家打算種下的數百萬棵樹」的修飾語有自己的主詞（非洲國家），英文用受格關係子句放在名詞後面：the millions of trees (that) African countries intend to plant；「數百萬棵樹」是 millions of trees（不確定的數量用 millions of）。「將被用來築成」用被動 will be used to form／build（be used to VR 表示「被用來…」，不要和 be used to V-ing「習慣於」混淆）。「橫跨非洲大陸的」寫成 across the African continent，放在 Great Green Wall 後面。
evidence: 非洲國家打算種下的數百萬棵樹
1.strategy_zh: 長的中文前置修飾語先拆成「名詞＋關係子句」；看到「被用來」就是 be used to VR。
hints: 切成四段：非洲國家打算種下的／數百萬棵樹／將被用來築成／一道橫跨非洲大陸的綠色長城
標的詞彙：country（國家）、intend（打算）、plant（種植）、millions of（數百萬）、tree（樹）、use（使用）、form（形成、築成）、wall（牆）、across（橫跨）、continent（大陸）
句型框架：The + N + (that) + S + intend to VR + will be used to VR + N + across …

2.explanation_zh: 「仍不確定…能否…」是間接問句：scientists are still not sure whether …，whether 後面用直述句語序 the Great Green Wall can halt …（不是 can the wall halt）。「由氣候變遷造成的沙漠擴張」修飾語在前，英文把分詞片語放到名詞後面：the expansion of deserts caused by climate change，沙漠擴張是「被」造成的，用過去分詞 caused；「擴張」在這裡是名詞 expansion／spread。
evidence: 仍不確定這道綠色長城能否擋住
由氣候變遷造成的沙漠擴張
2.strategy_zh: 「是否／能否」→ whether＋直述句；「由…造成的 N」→ N + caused by …。
hints: 切成四段：然而，科學家仍不確定／這道綠色長城能否擋住／由氣候變遷造成的／沙漠擴張
標的詞彙：scientist（科學家）、sure（確定的）、wall（牆）、stop（擋住，也可用 halt）、cause（造成）、climate change（氣候變遷）、desert（沙漠）、expansion（擴張）
句型框架：However, S + are still not sure whether + S + can + V + N + p.p. + by …

traps.explanation_zh: 「沙漠擴張」在句中是名詞片語，要寫成 the expansion／spread of deserts；照字面寫 desert expand 會變成主詞＋動詞。

bonus.text: However, whether this Great Green Wall can hold back deserts spreading as a result of climate change remains an open question.
bonus.explanation_zh: 把 whether 子句整個當主詞，後面接 remains an open question（仍是未解的問題），句構更緊湊。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「…能否擋住…」英文把「能否」移到子句開頭寫成 whether …，後面用直述句語序 the Great Green Wall can halt …；「由氣候變遷造成的沙漠擴張」修飾語在前，英文改成 the expansion of deserts caused by climate change，分詞片語放在名詞後面。
2.notes_zh: 第 3 部分寫成關係子句 that／which is caused by climate change 也表達同樣的後位修飾，算作 PART 這一格的可接受寫法（已列入 accepted）。whether 也可用 if。第 4 部分寫 the spread of deserts、desert expansion、the advancing desert 都可以；第 2 部分「擋住」寫 stop、halt、hold back、block 都可以。

1.translation: The millions of trees that African countries plan to plant will be used to build a Great Green Wall that stretches across the African continent.
1.explanation_zh: 「非洲國家打算種下的數百萬棵樹」用關係子句修飾 trees；「將被用來築成」用 will be used to build；「橫跨非洲大陸的」用關係子句 that stretches across the African continent。

2.translation: However, scientists are still not sure whether this Great Green Wall can stop the expansion of deserts caused by climate change.
2.explanation_zh: 「仍不確定…能否」用 are still not sure whether；「由氣候變遷造成的」用過去分詞片語 caused by climate change 修飾 the expansion of deserts。

1.explanation_zh: 「打算種下的數百萬棵樹」用 The millions of trees that ... plan to plant；「將被用來築成」用 will be used to build（被動加不定詞表目的）；「橫跨非洲大陸」用 that stretches across the African continent。

2.translation: However, scientists are still not sure whether the Great Green Wall can stop the expansion of deserts caused by climate change.
2.explanation_zh: 「仍不確定……能否」用 are still not sure whether ...；「擋住沙漠擴張」用 stop the expansion of deserts；「由氣候變遷造成的」用過去分詞片語 caused by climate change 修飾 deserts' expansion。這裡 caused by 的修飾對象略有歧義（沙漠或擴張），但意思不影響。
